pub struct Tref { /* private fields */ }
Expand description

The <tref> svg tag.

§Content

anyNumberOfElementsAnyOrder

§Elements

These elements are allowed to appear within this tag:

  • <animate>
  • <animateColor>
  • <desc>
  • <metadata>
  • <set>
  • <title>
